Subject: Post-call: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery so we can put together a preliminary cost estimate and mutual action plan. Please confirm any changes inline.

Recap (what we heard):
- Primary product flow: in-app chat completions for support + workflow automation (customer-facing).
- Search layer: embeddings for semantic search across knowledge base; batched re-indexing daily.
- Reranking: small rerank model applied to top N search candidates on high-value queries.
- Current go-live target: Q4 2027; pilot with 100-300 power users in Sept.

Quantitative asks (please confirm):
- Monthly token volumes (ballpark): chat completions: 50M tokens/month; embeddings (ingest + query traffic): 10M tokens/month; rerank: 2M tokens/month.
- Desired price target / unit economics: target $/1M tokens between $350- $500 (you mentioned budget sensitivity around this).
- Per-model mix (if known): chat ~75%, embeddings ~20%, rerank ~5% (we used above to estimate).

What we (Redwood) will deliver next:
- Preliminary cost estimate (attached spreadsheet) showing blended price at multiple model mixes and a separate column for Dedicated capacity vs Hosted.
- Suggested model variants (higher-quality chat vs cheaper background model) and impact on $/1M tokens.
- Shortlist of SLA/burst capacity options and estimated lead times.

Next steps:
1) Alex: confirm the monthly token volumes (chat / embeddings / rerank) and target $/1M if different.
2) Marissa: send an updated estimate by EOD tomorrow and propose 30-min follow-up demo of the Redwood console next week.

Attachments: Redwood-pricing-estimate-BrightLayer.xlsx (baseline calc), MA-terms-summary.pdf (very high level).

Thanks - Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the recap, Marissa - this looks right. A few clarifications/updates from our side:

Confirmed monthly volumes (updated):
- Chat completions: ~60M tokens/month (peak in product launch months).
- Embeddings (queries + daily re-indexing): ~8M tokens/month.
- Rerank: ~2.5M tokens/month.

Per-model split (how we expect to use models):
- Chat (UI-facing completions, highest quality): ~75% of total compute.
- Embeddings (vector search & embeddings for new content): ~20%.
- Rerank (lightweight model applied to top candidates): ~5%.

Budget / unit economics:
- Our procurement target is roughly $25k- $40k/month for the pilot phase.
- That implies a blended target of ~$350- $500 / 1M tokens depending on model mix and SLA.

Model variants:
- For chat, we want to evaluate a higher-quality chat model for agent-facing flows and a lower-cost distilled model for background summarization tasks - curious how Redwood supports multi-model routing and cost breakdowns per route.

Questions for Redwood team:
1) Can you provide a blended monthly estimate at three price points ($350/$425/$500 per 1M tokens) using the volumes above?
2) What are the typical latency SLOs for the hosted plan at those price points and any dedicated options (p95 p50 numbers)?
3) Anything we should know about caching / prefix reuse that could materially change token billing for our chat flows?

Happy to hop on a 30-minute follow-up next Tue or Wed - we prefer afternoon PT.

Best,
Alex Johnson
Head of Product, BrightLayer
alex.johnson@brightlayer.ai
